result.description:
VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced an Architectural Draftsperson to join our clients' business Kubra Building Services Pty Ltd in Hawthorn East. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

The successful applicant will be responsible for assisting construction managers, architects and surveyors in the planning and organisation of construction projects. This is a hands-on drafting role suitable for a candidate with practical experience in preparing drawings, interpreting plans and coordinating project documentation.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assist construction managers, architects and surveyors with planning, design coordination and project organisation.
- Interpret architectural plans, building regulations, standards and codes of practice.
- Prepare preliminary sketches, working drawings, specifications and detailed documentation for construction projects.
- Prepare, edit and revise plans, maps, charts and technical drawings using drafting software and relevant tools.
- Review drawings and documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency and compliance with project requirements.
- Coordinate works programs and assist with project documentation and scheduling requirements.
- Collaborate with architects, engineers, builders and other stakeholders to support project delivery.
- Maintain accurate records of drawings, revisions and project documentation.
- Ensure drafting work is completed in accordance with industry standards and workplace procedures.

Requirements:

- Relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design or a related field.
- Relevant experience as an Architectural Draftsperson, Building Designer or similar role.
- Ability to interpret architectural drawings, plans, regulations and construction documentation.
- Experience preparing and revising technical drawings and specifications.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in drafting work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good understanding of construction processes and documentation requirements.

Salary: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 per annum plus superannuation

Location: Level 1, Suite 3, 785 Toorak Road, Hawthorn East, VIC 3123

Hours: 38 hours per week

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Residential Workshop Fitter for Port Hedland

About Orontide

Orontide is a Veolia company located in Western Australian providing Hydrocarbon solutions, specialist engineering, fabrication, preservation, and integrity maintenance services to the Oil & Gas, Mining, Naval Defence, Marine and Commercial Industries. 

As a result of the company’s continued growth, an excellent opportunity has become available for suitably qualified and experienced Workshop Fitters to join our Port Hedland based team.

Rate $50.00– $65.00 per hour

To be successful for this position, you must possess the following experience:

- Determines suitable material, method and sequence of operations and machine settings
- Fits fabricated metal parts and assembles them
- Checks metal parts for accuracy, clearance and fit
- Sets guides, stops and other controls on machining tools, sets up prescribed cutting and shaping tools and dies in machines and presses, and sets controls for textile machines
- Forms metal stock and castings to press, cut, grind, plane, bore and drill metal
- Cuts, threads, bends and installs hydraulic and pneumatic pipes and lines
- Prepares pattern mechanisms to control the operation of textile machines used to spin, weave, knit, sew and tuft fabric
- Performs maintenance of machines, mechanical parts and fluid power equipment
- May erect machines and equipment

Required Tickets:
- Australian Recognized Trade certificate 
- C class drivers’ license
- High Risk Work License (LF and WP) Desirable

Why Choose us?

We embrace change, new ideas and promote a culture of innovation, respect and equal opportunity. Our stimulating and challenging work environment will present you with many opportunities to grow, develop and improve your skills.

Orontide is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and embraces cultural diversity and inclusion, and we welcome applications from all backgrounds.

Join Above Benchmark: Become a Professional Mystery Shopper!


Are you ready to be the eyes and ears for Australia’s favourite Mystery Shopping provider?

At Above Benchmark, we live and breathe Mystery Shopping. We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.
* Reliability and Compliance: A proven ability to read, understand, and meticulously follow detailed instructions and deadlines for every assignment. Some surveys require photos or receipts to be uploaded as proof. 


How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Payment Structure: Mystery Shop payments are different for each assignment and are based on the time and effort needed. Typically, payments range from $20-$50 (sometimes more) for onsite visits and $15-$30 for phone calls.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy independent work, and meet the requirements above, we encourage you to apply and help us ensure all our clients deliver a truly Above Benchmark experience!


Where to find out more information?

If you’d like more information about what we do, please visit our website for more details and informative blogs. There you’ll find links to our social sites where you can read more about our business as well as testimonials and reviews from our Mystery Shoppers and clients. https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopping-jobs/


How do you apply?

Our confidential application form can be found here: https://abovebenchmark.com.au/mystery-shopper-application/


We look forward to your application!
